name: Sub-Voxel Volume Clipping
definition: Clips a single voxel's sub-voxel field along the faces of a frustum volume. The fill value falls off linearly across the face, ensuring seamless reconstruction when pieces are reassembled.
summary: Sub-Voxel Volume Clipping smooths voxel boundary intersections by distributing fill values across sub-voxels, providing a linear density falloff instead of binary classification.
